source_refs.note: Exercise 7.1, Question 5 (book p. 230); the book prints no answers for Exercise 7.1; answers checked with sympy and the solution book

blocks.prompt: 5 (a) Figure 7.12 shows the velocity-time graph of an object moving in a straight line over a 12-second time interval. At what time did the object change its direction of motion?
blocks.explanation:
Velocity ka sign direction batata hai: positive matlab aage, negative matlab peeche.
Diya kya hai? Figure 7.12 ka velocity-time graph.
Find kya karna hai? Woh waqt jab object ki direction badalti hai, yani jab v ka sign badalta hai.
Plan: (5, 4) se (10, -2) wali neeche aati line time axis ko kahan kaat'ti hai, woh nikalna.
steps:
Diya gaya: velocity-time graph jo (0, 0), (3, 4), (5, 4), (10, -2), (12, -2) se guzarta hai. Figure par units nahi likhe; hum v ko m/s aur t ko seconds mein lete hain.
Maloom karna: direction badalne ka waqt.
Tareeqa: v > 0 ho to object aage ja raha hai, v < 0 ho to peeche. Is liye object wahan murta hai jahan v = 0 ho kar apna sign badalta hai, yani graph time axis ko cross karta hai.

Neeche aati line ka slope
\[m = \dfrac{-2 - 4}{10 - 5} = -\dfrac{6}{5}\]
Kyun: do kone wale points (5, 4) aur (10, -2) se slope nikala: rise / run.

Line ki equation
\[v - 4 = -\dfrac{6}{5}(t - 5)\]
Kyun: point-slope form, point (5, 4) ke saath. Ab is line par kisi bhi waqt ki velocity nikal sakte hain.

\(v = 0\) rakhein
\[t - 5 = 4 \times \dfrac{5}{6} = \dfrac{10}{3}\]
\[t = \dfrac{25}{3} \approx 8.33\]
Kyun: murne ke lamhe par velocity zero hoti hai. Dono taraf ko \(-\frac{5}{6}\) se multiply kiya. Figure ne bhi time axis par 25/3 likha hai, jo humare jawab se milta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[4 - \dfrac{6}{5}\left(\dfrac{25}{3} - 5\right) = 4 - 4 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(t = 25/3\) rakhne se v zero aata hai.
Dhyan dein: \(t = 10\) par graph ka kona hai, lekin wahan v = -2 hi rehta hai, yani negative; object peeche hi chalta rehta hai. Wahan sirf acceleration badalta hai, direction nahi.

blocks.prompt: 5 (b) Figure 7.12 shows the velocity-time graph of an object moving in a straight line over a 12-second time interval. Calculate the total distance travelled and the displacement of the object during the 12 seconds.
blocks.explanation:
Distance aur displacement dono velocity-time graph ke neeche ke areas se nikalte hain.
Diya kya hai? Time axis ke oopar ka area A1 aur neeche ka area A2.
Find kya karna hai? 12 second mein total distance aur displacement.
Plan: 7.1.5 ke Note ke mutabiq distance = A1 + A2 aur displacement = A1 - A2.
steps:
Diya gaya: Figure 7.12 ka graph aur part (a) se murne ka waqt t = 25/3.
Maloom karna: 12 s mein total distance aur displacement.
Tareeqa: Note (7.1.5): \(A_1\) time axis ke oopar ka area aur \(A_2\) neeche ka area ho, to displacement \(= A_1 - A_2\) aur distance \(= A_1 + A_2\). Har area ko aasaan shakalon (triangles aur rectangles) mein tor lete hain.

Axis ke oopar ka area, \(0 \le t \le \frac{25}{3}\)
\[\tfrac{1}{2}(3)(4) = 6\]
\[2 \times 4 = 8\]
\[\tfrac{1}{2}\left(\tfrac{10}{3}\right)(4) = \tfrac{20}{3}\]
\[A_1 = 6 + 8 + \tfrac{20}{3} = \tfrac{62}{3}\]
Kyun: 0 se 3 tak triangle, 3 se 5 tak rectangle, aur 5 se \(\frac{25}{3}\) tak triangle jis ka base \(\frac{25}{3} - 5 = \frac{10}{3}\) hai. Teeno ka jama \(A_1\) hai.

Axis ke neeche ka area, \(\frac{25}{3} \le t \le 12\)
\[\tfrac{1}{2}\left(\tfrac{5}{3}\right)(2) = \tfrac{5}{3}\]
\[2 \times 2 = 4\]
\[A_2 = \tfrac{5}{3} + 4 = \tfrac{17}{3}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{25}{3}\) se 10 tak triangle (base \(\frac{5}{3}\), height 2) aur 10 se 12 tak rectangle. Yahan hum area ka size lete hain; minus ka istemal agle qadam mein hoga.

Distance aur displacement
\[\text{Distance} = \tfrac{62}{3} + \tfrac{17}{3} = \tfrac{79}{3}\]
\[\approx 26.33\text{ m}\]
\[\text{Displacement} = \tfrac{62}{3} - \tfrac{17}{3} = 15\text{ m}\]
Kyun: distance mein dono areas jama hote hain kyunke object ne dono raaste tay kiye. Displacement mein peeche wala hissa minus hota hai kyunke woh aage wale safar ko kuch had tak wapas le aata hai.
Dhyan dein: sirf ek bara integral ya poora area jama kar ke displacement na likhein; neeche wala area minus hona zaroori hai.

Tasdeeq: trapeziums se
\[A_1 = \tfrac{1}{2}\left(\tfrac{25}{3} + 2\right)(4) = \tfrac{62}{3} \;\checkmark\]
\[A_2 = \tfrac{1}{2}\left(\tfrac{11}{3} + 2\right)(2) = \tfrac{17}{3} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: har hissa ek trapezium bhi hai: oopar wale ki parallel sides \(\frac{25}{3}\) aur 2, neeche wale ki \(12 - \frac{25}{3} = \frac{11}{3}\) aur 2. Doosre tareeqe se bhi wohi areas aaye.
blocks.final_answer: Distance \(= \frac{79}{3} \approx 26.33\) m; displacement \(= 15\) m (aage ki taraf)

blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 7.1 ke jawab chhape hue nahi hain. Is page ka har jawab hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam hal kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. Is liye aap apna jawab yahan wale jawab se mila kar dekh sakte hain.
